sentences.text:
For the State : Mrs. Kumari Rashmi, A.P.P.
----
th 02/Dated: 19 January, 2023
1. Issue notice to the opposite party no.2, both under registered cover with A/D as well as ordinary
process, for which requisites etc. must be filed within a week.
2. Heard learned counsel for the applicant and learned counsel for the State.

3. The applicant who is in custody since 26.09.2022 has approached this Court for grant of regular bail in connection with Complaint Case No.1244 of 2019, registered for the offence under Sections 420, 406 and 34 of the Indian Penal Code and under Section 138 of N.I. Act.
4. It appears that the applicant is accused of defrauding in the land transaction.
5. Innocence has been claimed by the learned counsel for the applicant and undertaking has been given for participation in the trial.
On the above basis, prayer for bail has been made.

sentences.text: 6. Learned counsel for the State has opposed the prayer for bail.

7. Considering the above facts, the applicant, named above, is directed to be released on provisional bail for six weeks from the date of receipt/production of a copy of this order, on furnishing bail bond of Rs.10,000/- (Rupees Ten Thousand Only) with two sureties of the like amount each to the satisfaction of the learned Additional Chief Judicial Magistrate, Koderma in connection with Complaint Case No.1244 of 2019, subject to condition that the applicant will submit self-attested photocopy of his Aadhaar Card and also submit his mobile number before the learned court below which he will always keep active and will not change it during pendency of this case without prior permission of the court.
8. Put up this case after five weeks.
(Rajesh Kumar, J.) Amar/-
